classifications.full: all shared components not listed as adapted

fidelity.gap: Add browser contracts for keyboard navigation, loop boundaries, multi-slide stepping, and focus retention.
Add visual regression coverage for token resolution, responsive resize, tooltip content, and dark mode.
Add browser contracts for filtering, grouped results, empty state, active descendant, and selection.
Add pointer-coordinate, keyboard fallback, focus return, submenu, and viewport-collision browser contracts.
Add browser contracts for left/right wrapping, submenu navigation, Escape, and focus restoration.
Add browser contracts for disclosure semantics, keyboard traversal, focus restoration, and responsive layout.
Add pointer and keyboard resizing contracts with minimum-size and total-width invariants.
Add cross-browser keyboard and high-contrast coverage for native scrollbars.
Add browser contracts for keyboard steps, range thumb constraints, orientation, and ARIA values.
Add hover, focus, touch dismissal, delay cancellation, collision, and accessible-description contracts.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Uses framework-native SVG and ECharts adapters rather than the React-only Recharts composition engine.
Uses a controlled Foldkit model rather than Embla's plugin API.
Captures cursor coordinates from secondary pointer-down because Foldkit OnContextMenu carries only a Message.
Receives the measured group extent explicitly because pure Foldkit pointer Messages do not expose currentTarget bounds.
Uses accessible native scrollbars rather than decorative custom scrollbar parts.
